body.cap: 10kM.ai is demonstrating its AI-driven video production solution, GemGem Video, at CES 2026. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: 10kM.ai (CEO Yuseok Kim) announced that it achieved export consultation results nearing 80 billion KRW at CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and tech exhibition held in Las Vegas early last month.

10kM.ai is a startup that develops AI-based video generation solutions. While promoting the commercialization of GemGem Video, a service that automatically produces videos with probability and completeness using only a small number of images, the company presents an alternative that drastically lowers the entry barrier for video content-oriented marketing.

Previously, 10kM.ai verified marketability by repeatedly conducting PoCs and pilot operations of GemGem Video in collaboration with domestic small and medium-sized enterprises, brand marketing organizations, and content production companies of various sizes. By participating in CES 2026, the company also significantly expanded its opportunities for collaboration with global companies.

Experts interpret this achievement as stemming from the overwhelming convenience provided by GemGem Video. The solution analyzes one to four user-uploaded images to construct a story and automatically produces complete video content, including natural cuts, subtitles, and audio.

In particular, GemGem Video offers specialized features for producing content for internal and external corporate communications and marketing, including brand promotional videos, product introductions, greeting messages, and event announcements. Using this can significantly reduce the burden of repetitive video production and help maximize production speed and cost efficiency, especially for small organizations.

body.cap: Appearance of the 10kM.ai booth participating in CES 2026. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: At the exhibition site, the company demonstrated GemGem Video’s capabilities, allowing visitors to experience the speed, simplicity, and intuitiveness that define the service. As a result, 10kM.ai received 149 consultations over four days. The cumulative consultation value resulting from this reached 54.4 million USD (approximately 79.119 billion KRW).

A 10kM.ai official stated, “While there have been several attempts to produce videos with generative AI technology, GemGem Video sought differentiation by maximizing its purpose and specialized strengths.” They added, “Through this, we confirmed explosive demand in the global marketing and education markets, and we plan to seek entry into North America, Japan, Southeast Asia, and other regions.”

They continued, “Based on positive feedback for GemGem Video, which instantly generates high-quality promotional videos from images alone, we held discussions with many potential customers at the exhibition site. Based on this, we plan to accelerate our entry into the global SaaS market.” They concluded, “Furthermore, through step-by-step expansion of sales channels, we will create an era where anyone can easily produce creative video content.”

Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
